verdict.rationale: Runpod ships official MCP servers and agent-skills plugins explicitly enabling natural-language operation: 'you can ask your agent to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy your own code with Flash, all in natural language,' plus documented migration via slash-commands to a coding agent. This is corroborated by dedicated docs pages for MCP servers and agent skills, giving first-party evidence of NL-driven agentic control. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of natural-language command success and broader community confirmation beyond vendor docs.
